question_cn: 连通兵（两个兵相邻，互相保护）比孤立兵的优势是：
question_en: Connected pawns (adjacent, mutually protected) vs. isolated pawns — the advantage is:

options.text_cn: 连通兵可以互相保护推进，对方王无法单独吃掉其中一个
options.text_en: Connected pawns advance while protecting each other; enemy king can't capture one without the other threatening to promote

options.text_cn: 连通兵不需要王的保护
options.text_en: Connected pawns don't need king protection

options.text_cn: 连通兵可以直接将死对方王
options.text_en: Connected pawns can directly checkmate the enemy king

explanation_cn: 连通兵的元思维：互相保护创造的是"对方王无法兼顾"的局面。吃一个兵，另一个就升变——这种牵制是双兵对双兵残局最重要的战略资源。
explanation_en: Meta-concept: mutual protection creates 'can't take one without the other promoting.' This zugzwang-like dilemma is the most powerful strategic resource in two-pawn endgames.
